scripts.dev: concurrently -n livekit,server,client,parser -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev:livekit" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:parser"
scripts.parser:setup: python3 -m venv parser-service/.venv && parser-service/.venv/bin/pip install -r parser-service/requirements.txt https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/download/en_core_web_sm-3.8.0/en_core_web_sm-3.8.0-py3-none-any.whl
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client-v2 && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client-v2 && cp -n .env.example .env 2>/dev/null || true
